GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

10. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

11. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

13. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
